sentences.text: This synthetic document describes the Ni–Ti binary system as calculated with pycalphad from the SGTE dataset NiTi-04Tok.tdb; every figure, table and stated value is generated, and the exact values are kept in a separate truth key.
The highest invariant reaction, L → (Ni) + Ni3Ti, lies at 1575.6 K.
The Ni–Ti system belongs to the 20 binaries of the ORCHID benchmark, chosen to cover diagram types such as intermetallic rich, congruent compound.
The thermodynamic description is the SGTE collection entry [1], which reproduces the assessment of T. Tokunaga, K. Hashima, H. Ohtani, M. Hasebe, Mater. Trans. JIM, 45, 1507-14(2004). [2].
The calculations use pycalphad 0.11.2 at 1 atm.
For Ni, the liquidus meets the axis at 1728.2 K.
Pure Ti melts at 2498.8 K.
We obtain 1575.6 K for the eutectic reaction (L → (Ni) + Ni3Ti), where L has 16.6 at.% Ti.
At 1393.0 K the eutectic L → Ni3Ti + NiTi takes place; the L phase then contains 38.4 at.% Ti.
We obtain 1259.5 K for the peritectic reaction (NiTi + L → NiTi2), where L has 66.9 at.%.
At 1216.3 K the eutectic L → NiTi2 + (βTi) takes place; the L phase then contains 74.6 at.%.
We obtain 1040.8 K for the eutectoid reaction ((βTi) → NiTi2 + (αTi)), where (βTi) has 94.7 at.% Ti.
Ni3Ti melts congruently at 1649.4 K and 23.6 at.% Ti.
NiTi melts congruently at 1584.9 K and 50.2 at.% Ti.
Table 1 compares the calculated temperatures with experimental values from the literature [3–5]; in this synthetic document those values and references are fictitious.
The upper stability limit of NiTi2 is 1259.5 K.
The solubility of Ti in (Ni) reaches 15.7 at.% at 1575.6 K.
At 2600 K the integral mixing enthalpy of the liquid has its minimum, −40840 J/mol, at 38.0 at.% Ti.
The calculated enthalpy of formation of NiTi at 298.15 K is −33.34 kJ/mol per mole of atoms.
Per formula unit NiTi this is −66.7 kJ/mol.
Its heat capacity at room temperature is 25.47 J/(mol K).
For the equiatomic liquid at 2600 K, the Gibbs energy of mixing is −30.75 kJ/mol-atom.
This document is synthetic and exists only to test extraction tools; its truth key lists every boundary, field, invariant, plotted point, table cell and stated value.
